title: Runtime Harness: Workload wrappers, controller, profiles, metrics, reporting
description:
Implement runtime cross-cutting test harness core from docs/plans/16-runtime-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §2-5 (architecture, suite structure, workload models, metrics & SLAs)

Key deliverables:
- Workload interface: Setup/Run/Teardown pattern wrapping Mode 2 and Mode 3 E2E scenarios
- Controller orchestration: goroutine pools per mode, unified telemetry collection
- Concurrency profiles: P-small (10 sessions), P-medium (50), P-large (200+)
- Soak profiles: 12h/24h with drift monitoring (goroutine <5%, RSS <10%, fd ±2, RPC error slope <0.01%/hr)
- 5 test families in e2etests/runtime/:
  - Load scaling tests (concurrency + throughput)
  - Soak stability tests (long-duration + drift)
  - Snapshot growth analysis (storage + retention)
  - Container boot benchmarks (Tier 2 cold-start)
  - RPC latency profiling (p50/p95/p99 + retry/error)
- Baseline management: baselines/ directory, comparison engine, regression gating
- Artifact generation: JSON/CSV metrics, markdown reports, storage growth reports
- Host config: hosts.yaml for CI fleet
- CI tiers: PR-fast ~5m, PR-standard ~30m, Nightly ~4h, Weekly ~36h

AC: Load harness executes P-small/P-medium, soak detects regressions, snapshot analysis automated, container benchmarks repeatable, RPC profiled under load, baseline gating works.

Depends on: Mode 3 E2E core (aiag-orl.1) and Mode 2 E2E core (aiag-91v.1).
